definition.alert_latency: alert time of the first episode overlapping the label window minus the stopped run's start
definition.box_stillness: maximal run of messages around the label start, grown backwards then forwards, whose positions fit a 2 m side box
definition.gap_spanning: alert whose evidence window ((t-W, t] for N2-W, (t-660, t] for N1) intersects a gap > 60 s between consecutive messages
definition.label_match: fleet/adapters/moroop.py label_comparison with run_intervals substituted by the rule's episodes
definition.position_rules: N1 and N2-W are position rules, not the Detector (MoRoOp driving counts rotation in place as moving)

rules.N1: InOrbit unableToNavigate: 60 s box diagonal < 2 m held at every grid second of [t-600, t]; start = alert - 660
rules.N2-W: InOrbit stopped while on a mission: W s box side < 2 m, W in 30/60/120/180; start = alert - W
rules.ours: Detector(stations, station_radius, servicing_max_s auto), the -sb rule

definition.sim_scoring: fleet_analyser/score.py score_run per zone, stuck_after 30; N0 / ours rows keep the Detector's faulted_self episodes (excluded by score_run), N1 / N2-W rows have no error logic
definition.stuck_runs: number of alert episodes under the rule
definition.units: MoRoOp 0.5 m cells: side = (max cell - min cell) * 0.5 < 2.0 m, diagonal = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * 0.5 < 2.0 m; simulator: 2 m read as 2 cells, rows tagged scale 'assumed 1 cell = 1 m'
definition.windows: half-open (t-W, t] in event time; positions are a right-continuous step function (position(tau) = the last message with ts <= tau); the window's position set = the position carried at t-W plus every message position in (t-W, t]; a window starting before the first message is not evaluated

N1.scale: MoRoOp 0.5 m cells: side < 2 m is a spread of at most 3 cells, diagonal < 2 m is dx^2 + dy^2 < 16

N2-120.scale: MoRoOp 0.5 m cells: side < 2 m is a spread of at most 3 cells, diagonal < 2 m is dx^2 + dy^2 < 16

N2-180.scale: MoRoOp 0.5 m cells: side < 2 m is a spread of at most 3 cells, diagonal < 2 m is dx^2 + dy^2 < 16

fleet/data/s10-breakdown.scoring_definition: truth stuck step = robot message t (not the last) with driving false, orderId non-empty and errors empty whose next message has the simulator stuck flag; truth episode = maximal run of such steps of one robot and one orderId, start = ts of its first message, end = ts of the message after its last, kept when end - start >= stuck_after
